newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Fibre in 3-yr pact with PacTel.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Fibre in 3-yr pact with PacTel.

text.p: Advanced Fibre Communications Inc said that it was awarded a three-year contract to supply Pacific Telesis Group with local loop telecommunications equipment.
Company officials were not available to provide further financial details of the contract.

Advanced Fibre will provide local loop access equipment to deliver basic and advanced telephony services over copper, fiber optic, coaxial cable and wireless infrastructures for implementation in Telesis's network in California and Nevada.
Pacific Telesis is an SBC Communications Inc unit.
